answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the prism until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the quill of the next round. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. By the willow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
